backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining all data types (Report, Volunteer, Representative, Directory, etc.) and implementing persistent storage with blob storage, access control, and user approval systems for a civic reporting application.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of lazy loading for leader images in the AdminDirectory component's photo column using the existing LazyImage component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend components including MapView, ReportCard, CertificateGenerator, ReportForm, VolunteerDashboard, and other key UI components with their recent enhancements and functionality.
frontend/assets/.well-known/ic-domains: Empty configuration file for Internet Computer domain verification.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph tags, Twitter Card tags, structured data, and favicon configuration for the CivicReport application.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Internet Computer domain configuration file listing civicreport.xyz and www.civicreport.xyz as verified domains.
frontend/public/.well-known/ii-alternati: Internet Identity alternative origins configuration allowing authentication from civicreport.xyz and www.civicreport.xyz domains.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component with TanStack Router setup, defining all routes (dashboard, map, admin, volunteer, NGO/NPO, etc.), and implementing unique visitor tracking on mount.
frontend/src/components/AdminContentMana: Admin component for managing application logo with SVG file upload, validation (type and size checks), preview functionality, and logo history display with timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.t: Main admin dashboard component that provides tabbed navigation for managing reports, users, volunteers, NGO/NPO applications, content, directory, and feedback. Handles authentication via Internet Identity and includes modals for approving/rejecting applications with notes.
frontend/src/components/AdminDirectory.t: Admin interface for managing the political directory including states, union territories, constituencies, MPs, MLAs, and Prime Minister. Supports CRUD operations, photo uploads, import/export functionality, and filtering by Lok Sabha/Vidhan Sabha with search capabilities.
frontend/src/components/AdminFeedbackMan: Component for managing user feedback and contact submissions with filtering by type and status. Allows admins to update submission status, respond to feedback, and delete entries with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Simple login page for admin access using Internet Identity authentication. Displays a shield icon, login button, and informational note about admin initialization.
Admin user management interface for adding and removing admin principals. Includes validation to prevent self-removal, clipboard copy functionality for principal IDs, and refresh capability for the admin list.
Detailed report card component for admins with inline editing capabilities, photo replacement for main/proof/MLA/PM/CM images, status management, and certificate generation. Includes delete functionality with confirmation and displays location data with representative information.
frontend/src/components/AdminReportsTabl: Admin table component for managing reports with inline editing, photo uploads, status updates, pagination, location selection via map, and integration with representative directories. Supports filtering, deletion, and detailed report management including civic body and representative data.
frontend/src/components/AdminUserManagem: Admin interface for managing admin users by adding or removing principals, with validation, confirmation dialogs, and clipboard copy functionality. Prevents self-removal and displays current admin list.
frontend/src/components/CertificateGener: Generates downloadable certificates for resolved reports, displaying report details, photos of representatives (PM, CM, MP, MLA, civic body), and verified volunteer badges. Supports leader selection and renders certificates on canvas.
frontend/src/components/ContentManagemen: Admin interface for uploading and managing SVG logos with drag-and-drop support, preview, validation, and history tracking. Updates logo across the application and certificates.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard displaying reports with infinite scroll, filtering by issue type, status, and volunteer, and statistics (total, open, resolved, resolution rate). Loads reports in batches and sorts by timestamp descending.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with donation link to Buy Me a Coffee and a feedback/contact modal that allows users to submit feedback, bug reports, or contact messages. Includes legal disclaimer text and uses React hooks for form state management.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component displaying logo, title, language dropdown, and menu dropdown with role-based mode indicators (Admin, Volunteer, NGO/NPO, or Citizen) shown as liquid glass badges. Handles navigation to homepage with location refresh triggers.
frontend/src/components/KnowYourNeta.tsx: Component for browsing and searching elected representatives (Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha) with geolocation support to auto-select user's representatives. Features state/constituency filtering, search functionality, and photo modal display.
frontend/src/components/LanguageDropdown: Compact dropdown component for language selection that displays available languages with native names and a checkmark for the currently selected language. Handles click-outside detection to close the dropdown.
frontend/src/components/LazyImage.tsx: Lazy-loading image component using IntersectionObserver to defer loading images until they're near the viewport. Supports high/low priority loading modes and displays a placeholder during loading.
frontend/src/components/LeaderPreview.ts: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/LegalNoticeModal: Modal component for generating legal notices from reports, collecting user details, recipient information, incident details, and digital signature via canvas drawing. Includes form validation and checkboxes for accuracy confirmation and data processing consent.
frontend/src/components/MapView.tsx: Interactive map component using Leaflet to display civic issue reports with markers, clustering, filtering by status/type, and compact info cards showing report details with static map previews generated from OpenStreetMap tiles.
frontend/src/components/MenuDropdown.tsx: Main navigation dropdown menu providing access to analytics, volunteer/NGO/admin dashboards, authentication controls, and real-time statistics including total reports and unique visitors.
Dashboard for NGO/NPO users showing their organization profile, approval status, impact score, privacy settings toggle, and registration information with Internet Identity authentication.
Public directory listing approved NGOs/NPOs with search, filtering, and sorting capabilities, displaying organization details including contact info (based on privacy settings), impact scores, and join dates.
frontend/src/components/NgoNpoRegistrati: Registration form for NGOs/NPOs to apply for platform membership, collecting organization details, logo upload, contact information, mission statement, and privacy preferences with validation and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/PrintableComplai: Modal component for generating printable complaint documents with customizable fields (complainer name, civic body, contact). Includes functionality to create ZIP files containing complaint documents with embedded images converted to base64, using manual ZIP file creation with CRC32 checksums.
frontend/src/components/RecentReports.ts: Displays a grid of recent civic issue reports from the community with loading and error states. Shows up to a limited number of reports in a 2-column layout on desktop with a link to view all reports on the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ReportCard.tsx: Comprehensive report card component displaying civic issue details including location, images, status, and representative information (PM/CM/MP/MLA/civic body). Supports status updates with proof photos, certificate generation, printable complaints, legal notices, and volunteer verification badges.
frontend/src/components/ReportForm.tsx: Form component for submitting civic issue reports with photo upload, geolocation, issue categorization (pothole, garbage, streetlight, etc.), and automatic representative/constituency detection. Includes civic body selection, volunteer profile integration, and location data fetching with map display.
frontend/src/components/ReportList.tsx: Displays all civic reports in a responsive grid layout with loading, error, and empty states. Renders individual reports using the ReportCard component.
frontend/src/components/ReportPage.tsx: Individual report detail page that displays a single report using ReportCard component. Handles success message display after form submission with sessionStorage persistence and provides navigation back to home or dashboard on errors.
frontend/src/components/ReportVerificati: Displays a public verification page for individual civic reports, showing details like issue type, status, location, photos, and reporter information with color-coded badges and icons.
frontend/src/components/Roadmap.tsx: Implements a drag-and-drop roadmap feature management interface with three sections (Implemented, Under Consideration, Upcoming), allowing admins to create, edit, delete, and move features between sections with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Provides a tabbed interface for managing user profiles and admin access, allowing admins to assign roles via principal IDs and view session information with clipboard copy functionality.
frontend/src/components/VolunteerDashboa: Shows a volunteer's personal dashboard with profile information, statistics, privacy settings, and the ability to submit profile edit requests with photo uploads and view edit history.
frontend/src/components/VolunteerDirecto: Displays a searchable and sortable public directory of verified volunteers with contact information, respecting privacy settings for mobile numbers unless the viewer is an admin.
frontend/src/components/VolunteerRegistr: React component for volunteer registration that handles form submission with photo upload, validation, and integration with Internet Identity authentication and blob storage.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides language context with support for 8 Indian languages (English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Kannada, Bhojpuri) and comprehensive translation keys for the entire application.
frontend/src/contexts/LocationRefreshCon: React context that provides a mechanism to trigger location refresh across components using a refresh key counter.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating and refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
Empty file for content moderation functionality (not yet implemented).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks with login/logout functionality, identity management, and configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including reports, user profiles, volunteers, directories, feedback, and administrative functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom component classes for buttons, cards, Indian-themed borders, certificate frames, and liquid glass effect mode indicators for different user roles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking an admin directory application with a pending feature request to apply lazy loading to leader photo images using the existing LazyImage component.
unknown.txt: Empty or incomplete file containing only a closing XML/HTML tag.
